# create combined metadata column



```{r BPCells conversion}
getwd()
if (!file.exists("../intermediate_data/schulte_schrepping_berlin_monocytes_bpcells.rds")) {
  # store counts matrix as BPcells object while keeping metadata
seurat_monocytes <-  read_rds(paste0(path_data_file,
                                     "schulte_schrepping_monocytes_from_seurat_COVID19_PBMC_cohort1_10x_jonas_FG_2020-08-15.rds"))

write_matrix_dir(mat = seurat_monocytes[["RNA"]]$counts, dir = 'BPCells_matrices/schulte_schrepping_berlin_monocytes')
counts.mat <- open_matrix_dir(dir = 'BPCells_matrices/schulte_schrepping_berlin_monocytes')

meta_data <- seurat_monocytes@meta.data
seurat_monocytes <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts.mat)
seurat_monocytes@meta.data <- meta_data

write_rds(seurat_monocytes, "intermediate_data/schulte_schrepping_berlin_monocytes_bpcells.rds")
rm(list = ls())

}

```
# sketched data, probalby erase
```{r}
obj <- read_rds( "intermediate_data/schulte_schrepping_berlin_monocytes_bpcells")
keep <- obj |> count(sampleID) |> filter(n>100) |> pull(sampleID)
obj <- obj |> filter(sampleID %in% keep)
obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$sampleID)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj)


obj <- SketchData(object = obj, ncells = 30, method = "LeverageScore", sketched.assay = "sketch")
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "sketch"
write_rds(obj, "intermediate_data/schulte_Schrepping_10x_berlin_sketched.rds")

```


```{r process unintegrated}
if (!file.exists("C:/Users/Danne/R_projects/manteltext/intermediate_data/schulte_schrepping_berlin_monocytes_bpcells.rds")) {
  obj <- read_rds("C:/Users/Danne/R_projects/manteltext/intermediate_data/schulte_schrepping_berlin_monocytes_bpcells.rds")
keep <- obj |> count(sampleID) |> filter(n>100) |> pull(sampleID)
obj <- obj |> filter(sampleID %in% keep)
obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$sampleID)
obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj)
obj <- ScaleData(obj)
obj <- RunPCA(obj)

obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:10, reduction = "pca")
obj <- FindClusters(obj,  cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")

obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:10, reduction = "pca")
obj <- FindClusters(obj,  cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")

obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:10, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")
  
}
```

```{r}
if ( FALSE # not calculated because of exessive cumputing times
  #!"integrated.cca" %in% names(obj@reductions)
    ) {
  
  library(future)
plan("multicore", workers = 8)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 1300 * 1024^2)
obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = obj, method = CCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.cca",
  verbose = FALSE
)

obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:30)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 2, cluster.name = "cca_clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.cca")

write_rds(obj, "../intermediate_data/schulte_schrepping_10x_berlin.rds")

  
}


if ( FALSE # not calculated because of exessive cumputing times
  #!"integrated.rpca" %in% names(obj@reductions)
    ) {
  obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = obj, method = RPCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.rpca",
  verbose = FALSE,
)
write_rds(obj, "../intermediate_data/schulte_schrepping_10x_berlin.rds")
  
}


if ( !"umap.harmony" %in% names(obj@reductions)
    ) {
  obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = obj, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony",
  verbose = FALSE
)

obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
obj <- FindClusters(obj,resolution = 0.2, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")

obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
Idents(obj) <- "cluster_clean"
write_rds(obj, "../intermediate_data/schulte_schrepping_10x_berlin.rds")
}


if ( !"umap.mnn" %in% names(obj@reductions)
    ) {
  obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = obj, method = FastMNNIntegration,
  new.reduction = "integrated.mnn",
  verbose = FALSE
  )
  obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30)
  obj <- FindClusters(obj,resolution = 0.2, cluster.name = "mnn_clusters")
  obj <- FindClusters(obj,resolution = 0.1, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters_res0.1")
  obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.mnn")
  obj <- RunPCA(obj, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "pca_mnn")
  
  write_rds(obj, "../intermediate_data/schulte_schrepping_10x_berlin.rds")
}
```

```{r}
mnn_umap_dotplot <- function( feature, title=NA, subtitle_="log1p normalized",subtitle = "log1p normalized"){
 # browser()
  if (is.na(title)) {title <- feature}
  
  #dims_tbl <- collect_features(source=obj@reductions$umap.mnn@cell.embeddings, features = c("umapmnn_1","umapmnn_2")) |> as_tibble()

dims_tbl <- obj@reductions$umap.mnn@cell.embeddings |> as_tibble()

plot_ <- tibble(
  feature=collect_features(source =obj@assays$RNA$data,features = feature) |> pull({{feature}})
  ) |> bind_cols(dims_tbl)

#browser()
plot_ <- plot_ |> 
  ggplot(aes(-umapmnn_1, umapmnn_2,  color=feature))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, shape=16)+
  scale_color_viridis_c()+
  #scale_fill_viridis_c()+
  ggtitle(title,
          subtitle = subtitle_)+
  coord_fixed()+ggdark::dark_theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  family = "Calibri", size=18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                     family = "Calibri", size=11),
        title = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        text = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=12))+
  xlab("umap dim. 1 (FastMNN)")+
  ylab("umap dim. 2 (FastMNN)")+
  labs(color=feature)

return(plot_)
  
}
```

```{r}
mnn_umap_dotplot <- function( feature, title=NA, subtitle_="log1p normalized",subtitle = "log1p normalized", from_meta_data=FALSE){
 # browser()
  if (is.na(title)) {title <- feature}
  
  #dims_tbl <- collect_features(source=obj@reductions$umap.mnn@cell.embeddings, features = c("umapmnn_1","umapmnn_2")) |> as_tibble()

dims_tbl <- obj@reductions$umap.mnn@cell.embeddings |> as_tibble()
if (!from_meta_data) {plot_ <- tibble(
  feature=collect_features(source =obj@assays$RNA$data,features = feature) |> pull({{feature}})
  ) |> bind_cols(dims_tbl)
}else {plot_ <- tibble(
  feature=obj@meta.data[,feature]
  ) |> bind_cols(dims_tbl)}

#browser()
plot_ <- plot_ |> 
  ggplot(aes(-umapmnn_1, umapmnn_2,  color=feature))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, shape=16)+
  scale_color_viridis_c(values = c(0, 0.17, 0.35, 0.5,1)
                        )+
  #scale_fill_viridis_c()+
  ggtitle(title,
          subtitle = subtitle_)+
  coord_fixed()+ggdark::dark_theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  family = "Calibri", size=18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                     family = "Calibri", size=11),
        title = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        text = element_text(family = "Calibri"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=12))+
  xlab("umap dim. 1 (FastMNN)")+
  ylab("umap dim. 2 (FastMNN)")+
  labs(color=feature)

return(plot_)
  
}

```

```{r}
devtools::install_github("landerlabcode/BigSurR")

library(BigSur)
#Calculate the differential sequencing depths using the original seurat object
obj <- obj[, sample(colnames(obj), size =1000, replace=F)]

obj <- CreateSeuratObject(obj@assays$RNA@layers$counts, min.cells=1)

depths <- depth.scaling(obj, assay="RNA")

#Subset the seurat object to contain only genes of interest
genes.list <- VariableFeatures(obj)

example.seurat.subset <- subset(obj, features=genes.list)


#Run BigSur on the subsetted data with the depths vector as a parameter
library(Rmpfr)

output <- BigSur(example.seurat.subset, variable.features = F, correlations=T, depthlist = depths)


library(logr)
obj <- obj[, sample(colnames(obj), size =1000, replace=F)]

obj <- CreateSeuratObject(obj@assays$RNA@layers$counts, min.cells=1)
obj <- NULL
gc()
example.output <- BigSur(example.seurat, variable.feature=T, correlations=T)


```
